events.feedback:
This draft for the Starfruit (Averrhoa carambola) card is visually stunning and beautifully written. Slicing it to reveal the five-pointed star is such an iconic image, and your "Quick Hits" section captures that perfectly.

Because starfruit carries unique dietary guidelines, making sure this profile is completely air-tight is highly important. Here is a review of the text along with a couple of critical adjustments to protect park visitors:

🌟 Why it works
Phenomenal Botanical Notes: Describing the leaves as "pinnately compound... that fold down at night" (nyctinasty) is an amazing educational detail that curious visitors will love trying to spot if they visit near dusk.

Clear Origin & Habit Data: Capturing its native Southeast Asian roots and its heavy-fruiting nature is spot-on for a tropical specimen profile.

🚨 Critical Adjustments to Consider
The Kidney Warning (Crucial Nuance): You did an excellent job highlighting the danger of caramboxin and oxalates for people with kidney d
events.summary: The kidney-safety warning has been broadened across quick_hits, more_information, and toxicity to reflect peer-reviewed evidence that people with any degree of renal impairment (including undiagnosed) face serious risk, and that even healthy individuals are not completely exempt at very high consumption levels. The edibility and toxicity fields have also been migrated to their correct schema shapes (lists of strings).
